title: Remote sensing of Pu in uranyl nitrate crystals using reflectance spectroscopy and chemometrics
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,48807-48815
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08550K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Luke R. Sadergaski, Jeffrey D. Einkauf, Laetitia H. Delmau, Jonathan D. Burns
Remote quantification of Pu(VI) (0–5 mol%) co-crystallized with U in uranyl nitrate hexahydrate (UNH) crystals was achieved in a glove box using reflectance spectroscopy coupled with chemometric modeling.
